title: Add papyrus ops site copy to move a site's backend data into a new site
description: Copy DynamoDB tables and media from one Papyrus backend to another with explicit key rewrite rules, dry run by default, idempotent re-runs and a verify mode. First use: read.p.apyr.us (p-apyr-us) to Machines on Machines (machines-on-machines). Docs: docs/site-copy.md. Branch feature/site-copy.
